gridDNA: The layout features a top-heavy illustrated narrative scene with a speech bubble, leading down to a central product display within a bag, anchored by a strong, full-width offer banner at the bottom with a hero product shot.

zones.treatment: black bold text in white speech bubble with black outline, uppercase
zones.note: Acts as an immediate hook, question format, drawing attention to the quantity.

zones.position: top-right, starting 15% from top, pointing towards centre
zones.note: Directs eye flow towards the products in the bag.

zones.position: mid-canvas, starting 25% from top, filling central 40% vertically
zones.note: Visual representation of the quantity being discussed, central to the narrative.

zones.position: bottom-mid, starting 60% from top, flanking the bag
zones.note: Frames the product display in the bag, grounding the scene.

zones.position: bottom-centre, starting 65% from top, full width
zones.note: High contrast, dominant block for the primary value proposition.

zones.position: bottom-left, starting 65% from top, overlapping red banner and background
zones.note: Hero product shot, contrasts with the illustrated style of the upper canvas.

zones.position: bottom-left of banner, starting 68% from top
zones.treatment: white bold text, black outline, uppercase
zones.note: Primary value proposition, highly prominent within the offer banner.

zones.position: below main offer text, starting 76% from top
zones.treatment: white text, black outline, title case
zones.note: Clarifies the offer's benefit and scale.

zones.position: bottom-centre, starting 88% from top, full width
zones.note: Essential legal details or disclaimers, minimal visual weight.

typeScale: headline (speech bubble) ~10% of canvas height, main offer (banner) ~8%, sub-offer ~4%, caption ~2%
colourBlocking: Top 65% features a light, neutral background with illustrated elements. The bottom 25% is dominated by a solid, high-contrast red banner, with the very bottom 10% returning to the light background for the disclaimer.
negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the top-left and top-right corners, and around the central bag, allowing the illustrated narrative and the high-impact bottom offer to stand out clearly against the light background.
eyePath: The eye travels from the intriguing speech bubble headline -> to the pointing hand -> to the products in the bag (visual proof) -> then drops to the high-contrast red offer banner (main value proposition) -> the hero product -> the subheadline -> and finally the disclaimer.
whyItWins: The layout converts by first engaging the viewer with a relatable, curiosity-driven narrative illustration, then immediately resolving the implied question with a clear, high-value offer presented in a visually dominant bottom banner.
